items.title: Alvin "Red" Tyler Interview, 1996-06-19
items.q: I think that might have been after we had done some things with Smiley Lewis.

ctx.x: I feel like I'm going to be better with dates than you. So, yeah, so you remember first recordings with Dave? I mean, with the first...
I couldn't swear to it, but I imagine it might have been Smiley Lewis or somebody like that.
